name: qfd_stream_bf16_carry_1117

reset_landing.why: 2 registered face stages, last stage 28 kept copies (725 control reset loads in the yosys 0.68 keep-regs mapped census: roots, select leaves, P2 insertion leaves, open copies, config, valids, faults; <= 26 each); payload, derived pipeline words and held-word enables carry no reset

pin_regs.reason: The RTL registers every pin: every input bit is captured at its face in qfd_dv_stream_tile (sw/se payload, sid, cfg, SU write ports; the valid / tap-hit / write-any / config-enable bits as (* keep *) ROOT copies, which feed kept 14-bit select LEAF banks one edge later), every output is driven directly by a register (so_e/so_w relay, tw_*/xt_* tap output registers after the interior tap relay, fault).  A flow pin stage would add a second edge and fold the kept select copies into one flop per pin (1,088-load relay select).

fill_reason.pin_bound: 6,946 external pins: W/E 2,176 each (1,088-bit relay in + out), S 1,482 (low tap halves + SU write ports), N 1,113; <= 6 pins/um needs >= 371 um on W/E, so a 40-60 % outline (~120 x 120 um) cannot carry them. Compact fallback 259.2 x 380.16 (aspect 1.47): W/E 5.85 pins/um, S 5.9, N 4.4; relay W->E 259 um, shorter packer / tap wires (the larger s1 fallback 345.6 x 440.64 stretched the pin-flop ring to 147 ps spread). Pin-bound, waived (low util costs wire only).
